verdict.rationale: The docs describe a nightly refresh whose time can be changed per connection. They also let you stop a running sync and re-import past months after fixing them in the books, which covers the post-close refresh. Sheets and Drive files update the Model when the file changes. Nothing in the evidence shows each connected source displaying when it last synced. Missing for 10: per-source last-synced timestamp/status indicator, documented post-close refresh cadence beyond nightly, independent or hands-on corroboration.
